The '''Stalkers''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit led by [[Gennan Var]]. The members were armed with [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] [[GLX Firelance]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="HL" />
